event_data.context: Observed `tiber.ci_recovery.status({})` fail with `tiber.parse_error ci_recovery_incident_missing active=false`. The inactive state is expected and should be represented as data so callers can distinguish it from malformed active incident state.
event_data.summary: Return a normal inactive CI-recovery status when no incident exists instead of raising ci_recovery_incident_missing.
event_data.title: Make CI recovery status handle no active incident
